description:
Outcome: A member can cancel their own booking with at least two hours remaining, from README first-version scope.
Scope: Authorized cancellation through the shared write serialization; retain canceled records and release the slot and member quota. Excludes: staff policy overrides and UI.
Acceptance: Exactly two hours remaining permits cancellation; below two hours is denied; another member cannot cancel; repeated cancellation is safe; concurrent cancellation/create maintains slot uniqueness and quota.
Behaviour: Privacy-preserving authorization failures, clear late-cancellation errors, timezone-aware clock and safe repeated requests.
Verification: make test cutoff/ownership/retry/slot-reuse/quota-release and concurrency regression tests. Prerequisites: Enforce two upcoming bookings per member. Assumptions: Inclusive two-hour cutoff.
title: Own-booking cancellation and cutoff enforcement
